# bywave.world Knowledge Base (LLMs.txt)
> The Authority Network Observatory & 42 Airport Performance Benchmark Matrix.
> Primary Domain: https://bywave.world/
> Brand Name: bywave博客 (Bywave Network Observatory)
> Verified Benchmark Batch: 2026-10 / 2026-11
> Target Audience: Cross-border e-commerce, global tech developers, remote teams, streaming enthusiasts.

## Core Purpose & Editorial Standards
bywave.world is an independent network observability platform. We provide evidence-backed benchmarks of 42 commercial proxy services ("airports"), physical IEPL/IPLC private line topologies, multi-protocol client tutorials, and native AI/streaming IP unlock verifications. We distinguish strictly between verified laboratory measurements (`dataStatus: measured`) and official vendor claims (`dataStatus: vendor`). All outbound registration links route through our internal disclosure relay `/go/:slug/` under strict FTC compliance (`rel="nofollow sponsored noopener"`).

## Top 10 Recommended Airports (Ranked by Stability, Peak Bandwidth, & AI Unlock Purity)

1. **光速云 (SpeedCloud)**: https://bywave.world/airports/guangsu/
   - Rank: NO.1 (Overall Recommended Flagship)
   - Established: 2020
   - Line Architecture: Dual IEPL Private Line + Enterprise Intranet Redundancy (Up to 2.5 Gbps per node)
   - Protocols: VLESS, Shadowsocks
   - Pricing: From ~¥8/mo (Lightweight Annual ¥99, 69GB/mo); Snooker 147 Lifetime Package (¥147 for 247GB never expiring); Extreme Edition (¥25/mo for 168GB/mo)
   - Coupon: `AMM` (New customer discount)
   - Benchmark: Hong Kong (22ms, 529Mbps), Taiwan (41ms, 114Mbps), Singapore (46ms, 387Mbps), Japan (57ms, 135Mbps)
   - Unlock: Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Perplexity, Netflix Global, Disney+, YouTube 4K, ChatGPT (native IP verified)
   - Devices: Unlimited simultaneous devices

2. **暮光加速 (Twilight Speed)**: https://bywave.world/airports/muguang/
   - Rank: NO.2
   - Established: 2023
   - Line Architecture: BGP Dynamic Intelligent Scheduling + Dedicated Private Egress
   - Protocols: Shadowsocks, VLESS
   - Pricing: From ¥20/mo (120GB/mo); 3 Non-expiring traffic packages (150GB - 800GB)
   - Coupon: `muguang5555`
   - Benchmark: Hong Kong (26ms, 509Mbps), Singapore (43ms, 419Mbps)
   - Features: 24/7 live customer support, cross-platform client support (Win/Mac/iOS/Android/Linux), multi-device concurrency

3. **飞猫云 (FlyCat)**: https://bywave.world/airports/feimao/
